title: Anyone can run a 5-minute Mindless session signed out, and is offered "same time tomorrow?" after it

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 8 of the launch brief (ADR-1720), "and 8 if there's room" before 1 December. TODAY: the timer is /on-air, a protected path (proxy.ts:61; LIVE-136 made it protected), so the Calm down fast funnel, whose first win is a 5-minute Mindless session, hits a sign-in wall. "Same time tomorrow" copy exists for members only (lib/on-air.ts:680). THE FIX: a public no-account browser timer and breathing pacer (client only, no writes, nothing sent to analytics beyond a generic page view) with the 5-minute practice preset, and after a session a "same time tomorrow?" offer that leads to signup with the time kept. LIVE-800's Calm down fast door lands here once it ships. Member-facing: help line and changelog entry.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-805";const dirs=["app/(marketing)/mindless","app/(marketing)/timer","app/mindless","app/timer"].filter(d=>fs.existsSync(d+"/page.tsx"));if(!dirs.length)fail(ID+": no public timer page (app/(marketing)/mindless or /timer)");const px=r("proxy.ts");if(dirs.some(d=>px.includes("\"/"+p.basename(d)+"\"")))fail(ID+": the timer route is listed as protected in proxy.ts");const tree=dirs.flatMap(d=>walk(d)).map(r).join("\n")+walk("components").filter(f=>/public-timer|mindless-public/.test(f)).map(r).join("\n");if(!/same time tomorrow/i.test(tree))fail(ID+": the public timer does not offer same time tomorrow");if(!/(5|five).?min/i.test(tree)&&!/300/.test(tree))fail(ID+": no 5-minute practice on the public timer")'
verify.note: Fails while no unprotected timer page exists with a 5-minute practice and a same-time-tomorrow offer.
